name: lesswrong-mcp
description: Read-only search and retrieval for LessWrong and the Alignment Forum.
long_description: Research LessWrong and the Alignment Forum through five read-only tools: search posts, comments, tags, users and sequences, sorted by relevance, date or karma and filtered by date range, Alignment Forum status or one post's discussion; read a post; read a post's whole discussion, answers on question posts included, or one comment; list posts by author, tag, date range and karma, or the posts that link to a post; and read a sequence in order. Both forums share one backend; no authentication required.

tools.name: lw_search
tools.description: Search posts, comments, tags, users and sequences, sorted by relevance, date or karma, with date, Alignment Forum and in-discussion filters.

tools.name: lw_get_post
tools.description: Read a post's full body and metadata.

tools.name: lw_get_comments
tools.description: Read a post's whole discussion, answers on question posts included, or one comment.

tools.name: lw_filter_posts
tools.description: List posts by author, tag, date range and karma in a stated order, or the posts that link to a post.

tools.name: lw_get_sequence
tools.description: Read a sequence's posts in order.
